hero.title: Adoptable Pets — PawPlacer
hero.description: An organization's live PawPlacer pet listings, embedded via their script and an organization ID.

example.title: Example
example.description: Pets shown from the rescue's PawPlacer page. If it can't load, a plain link to the full list stays on the page.

disclosure: This example uses a placeholder PawPlacer organization ID, so the widget below shows PawPlacer's "not found" message; replace it with your own organization's ID to see your animals. This template and 4leggedIT are not affiliated with PawPlacer.

standard.title: Usage rules
items: On the client, lazily injects PawPlacer's `embed/component` script (once per page, shared across multiple instances) and calls their global `embedPawPlacerComponent('pets', organizationId, targetId, options)`. The mount target uses a generated unique DOM id (`useId()`-based) so multiple instances never collide.

`listingsUrl` defaults to `https://www.pawplacer.com/shelters/{organizationId}` — PawPlacer's equivalent of a Petfinder org profile page or an Adopt-a-Pet shelter page. Override only if the org's real listings page differs from that pattern.

Cross-links to `petfinderUrl` / `adoptAPetUrl` / `getbuddyUrl` render as "Or view all pets on X, Y, or Z." — the same sentence structure already used by `PetfinderScrollerEmbed`, `AdoptAPetEmbed`, and `GetBuddyEmbed`, which all accept a `pawPlacerUrl` in return, so every adoptable-pets embed can cross-link to every other one.
Wired into `AdoptablePetsSection` as mode `"pawplacer"` (and as one of the feeds shown in `"hybrid"` mode), matching how `getbuddy` is wired.
